meta.title: GTA VI Trophy Guide
meta.status: PROJECTED — Rockstar's official GTA VI trophy list has not been published via PSN. Every entry below is a projection modelled on the structure of the GTA V PS5 trophy list (verified via Exophase / TrueTrophies / TechRadar, Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and requirements will be replaced once Sony or Rockstar confirms the real list.
meta.modelledOn: Grand Theft Auto V PS5 base-game list: 51 trophies (1 platinum, 3 gold, 5 silver, 42 bronze) per TrueTrophies and PSMania; extended to 55 entries for this projection.

roadmap.title: Story playthrough (40-60h)
roadmap.text: Play the story once, freely switching between Jason and Lucia when the game allows. Ignore missable anxiety except for the choices flagged in the Missables section: pick the 'smart' ending when offered, and never sell unique vehicles or property. Explore casually but keep the in-game checklist in mind.

roadmap.title: Clean-up after the credits (30-50h)
roadmap.text: With the story done, every part of Leonida is open. Work through the 100% checklist category by category: collectibles first (they unlock vehicle and activity spawns), then hobbies and pastimes, then the odds-and-ends random events. Use the map filters in the game menu; this guide's app mirrors the same categories.

roadmap.title: Grind trophies (20-40h)
roadmap.text: Whatever remains: gold-medal replays on story missions via the mission replay menu, the wanted-level survival trophies, wealth-related purchases, and any 100%-completion stragglers. Nothing here is especially hard, just long.

missables.title: Final-mission choice
missables.text: As in GTA V, the last mission is expected to offer an outcome choice. One outcome is projected to lock the story-completion trophy set most cleanly; if Rockstar repeats the GTA V pattern (Ending C 'The Third Way' in GTA V), take the option that keeps both protagonists alive. There is no way to return to this choice without a fresh playthrough.

missables.title: Story-locked property and unique vehicles
missables.text: Any vehicle earned or unlocked during the story (safehouse garage spawns, mission reward cars) should be parked in a purchased garage, never sold. GTA V permanently removed story-unlocked cars on sale, and the same behaviour is projected here.

missables.title: Character-specific side content
missables.text: Stranger-and-Freaks-style threads that are tied to a single protagonist in GTA V (Trevor's Rampages, Franklin's bail bonds) became unfinishable if that character's story window closed. Assume some Leonida threads are tied to Jason or Lucia specifically and play them when they appear rather than saving them.

missables.title: One-shot random events
missables.text: Random events that spawn once (store robberies as victim, rescue events) may not respawn after failing or ignoring them. Interact with every event marker you see during the story.

trophies.name: Leonida Legend
trophies.description: Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.howTo: Complete the story, all 100% checklist items, collectibles and every other trophy. Projected difficulty 4/10 on the GTA V model (Metagame.guide rates the GTA V platinum 6/10 at ~246h; GTA VI's larger map suggests a comparable or longer grind but easier individual trophies).

trophies.name: Another Day in Paradise
trophies.description: Complete the opening missions and settle into life in Leonida.
trophies.howTo: Projected opening-mission trophy. Story trophies unlock automatically; play the prologue and first act. Name nods to Jason's confirmed line 'Another day in paradise, right?' (Rockstar, Only in Leonida).

trophies.name: Down the Keys
trophies.description: Complete the Leonida Keys chapter of the story.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy. Follow the main story markers through the Keys region.

trophies.name: Bright Lights, Vice City
trophies.description: Complete the first Vice City story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy. Automatic once you finish the Vice City story arc.

trophies.name: Out on Good Behaviour
trophies.description: Complete the missions around Lucia's release from Leonida Penitentiary.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Lucia begins the story freshly out of prison (Rockstar character bio); this trophy marks her early arc.

trophies.name: Better or Worse
trophies.description: Complete a mission sequence with both Jason and Lucia working together.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The duo dynamic ('Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him') anchors the story; expect a milestone trophy for the partnership solidifying.

trophies.name: The Easy Score
trophies.description: Complete the story's first major score.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Rockstar's premise is that 'an easy score goes wrong' — the trophy lands when the first big job is done.

trophies.name: Jack of Hearts
trophies.description: Complete the story arc involving Boobie Ike and Only Raw Records.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Boobie Ike is a confirmed Vice City character with a music-industry arc ('the club money pay for the studio, and the drug money pay for it all').

trophies.name: Darkest Side of the Sunniest Place
trophies.description: Reach the mid-game twist where the criminal conspiracy across Leonida comes into focus.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Directly modelled on Rockstar's official premise line: 'the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida.'

trophies.name: Gulf Coast Problems
trophies.description: Complete the Port Gellhorn story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed region of Port Gellhorn.

trophies.name: Up on Kalaga
trophies.description: Complete the Mount Kalaga story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed northern region of Mount Kalaga (hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals per Rockstar's region tour).

trophies.name: Sour Ambrosia
trophies.description: Complete the Ambrosia story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed region of Ambrosia.

trophies.name: River of Grass
trophies.description: Complete the Grassrivers story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed Everglades-inspired Grassrivers region.

trophies.name: Consequences
trophies.description: Complete the missions where the duo's past catches up with them.
trophies.howTo: Projected late-story trophy. Modelled on GTA V's The Moment of Truth slot (a mid-to-late story reveal).

trophies.name: To Live or Die in Leonida
trophies.missableNote: Choice-dependent finale; see the Missables section before the last mission.
trophies.description: Complete the final story mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected finale trophy, modelled on GTA V's 'To Live or Die in Los Santos'. Before starting the last mission read the missables warning about the projected ending choice.

trophies.name: Sunshine State of Mind
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be earned if any story mission becomes unrepeatable after the credits — replay anything missed before finishing the finale.
trophies.description: Complete every story mission in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The story trophy above the individual chapters: 100% of main missions. In GTA V this was folded into 100% completion; a standalone trophy is projected here given the longer story.

trophies.name: Solid Gold, Baby!
trophies.description: Earn gold medals on story missions (projected: 60+ or all missions).
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's exact trophy name as the archetype ('Earn any 70 Gold Medals on Missions, Strangers and Freaks'). Replay missions from the pause menu and chase the gold objectives shown per mission: time, accuracy, and special goals. Most are earned on a relaxed second pass.

trophies.name: Two of a Kind
trophies.description: Play as both Jason and Lucia during a single mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA VI's defining mechanic is a two-protagonist story; expect character-switching inside missions (GTA V gave 'Three Man Army' for the trio mechanic).

trophies.name: Career Criminal, Leonida Edition
trophies.description: Attain 100% game completion.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled directly on GTA V's 'Career Criminal' (100% required missions, strangers and freaks, hobbies and pastimes, collectible sets, random events, miscellaneous checklist items). Longest single trophy; work the in-game stat checklist after the credits.

trophies.name: Leonida Sightseer
trophies.description: Explore all of the state of Leonida and Vice City.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on 'San Andreas Sightseer'. Visit every named district of all six confirmed regions (Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga). Fog-of-war map completion, likely a percentage meter.

trophies.name: From Beyond the Sunshine
trophies.description: Collect and return all of a scattered collectible set (projected UFO/paranormal set, the GTA V spaceship-parts slot).
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on 'From Beyond the Stars' (GTA V spaceship parts). Expect 50-ish scattered objects with an in-game collectibles map unlock after a story milestone. Collect in bulk once the map markers are available.

trophies.name: A Mystery, Solved
trophies.description: Solve the mystery of a Leonida cold case.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'A Mystery, Solved' (the Leonora Johnson letter hunt) as the archetype. Projected: a multi-part clue collectible across one region, ending in a discovery scene.

trophies.name: Waste Management
trophies.description: Collect all of a hidden underwater or wilderness item set.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's nuclear-waste barrels ('Waste Management'). Likely a boat/diving collectible in the Keys or Grassrivers waters — buy the related property first if Rockstar repeats the GTA V dock requirement.

trophies.name: Only in Leonida
trophies.description: Find all of a photography- or landmark-based collectible set.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Rockstar's region tour names landmarks across six regions; expect a photo-op or landmark-discovery set (the RDR2 / GTA Online 'Peyote' style). Shoot or visit every marker.

trophies.name: Sunken Treasures
trophies.description: Recover all hidden packages across Leonida.
trophies.howTo: Projected classic-GTA hidden-package hunt. Projected count 50-100, water-accessible ones around the Keys. Grab them during free roam with a helicopter/boat.

trophies.name: Local Flora
trophies.description: Discover every wildlife or plant collectible in the backwoods.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on RDR2/GTA V peyote plants. Mount Kalaga's 'prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails' (Rockstar region tour) is the likely biome.

trophies.name: The Full Playlist
trophies.description: Hear every radio station at least once.
trophies.howTo: Projected, easy. Rockstar confirms 'the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet' across named genres (classic rock to blues) plus on-demand podcasts — cycle through all stations in any vehicle.

trophies.name: Podcast Addict
trophies.description: Listen to all on-demand podcast episodes.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA VI introduces 'on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia' via headphones (Rockstar, Nov 2026). Play every episode once through the phone/headphones UI.

trophies.name: Inside Job
trophies.description: Complete your first major heist.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The GTA V heist trophy pattern (Diamond Hard, Blitzed, Small Town Big Job, The Big One!) is projected to repeat with bigger scores across Leonida. Finish any planned multi-approach score.

trophies.name: Every Angle
trophies.description: Complete every available approach on at least one heist.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA V heists had stealth/loud/subtle variants replayable from the planning board. Re-run each approach on one heist to be safe.

trophies.name: The Big One!
trophies.description: Complete the story's final, largest heist.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'The Big One!' name. This is the climactic score of the campaign — automatic with the story.

trophies.name: Assemble the Crew
trophies.description: Complete a heist with a full crew of hired specialists.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Heist planning in GTA V involved picking crew members with skill/cut trade-offs. Hire a complete crew for one job.

trophies.name: Clean Getaway
trophies.description: Complete a heist without alerting anyone (ghost approach).
trophies.howTo: Projected. Modelled on the GTA Online heist all-silent bonus pattern. Save before the approach, go slow, use suppressed weapons and the stealth route.

trophies.name: Equal Shares
trophies.description: Complete a heist taking the maximum cut yourself, or finish one on the hardest difficulty setup.
trophies.howTo: Projected. One of two plausible variants for a heist-economics trophy; do both to be safe. Choose the max-cut setup in planning and survive the worse-crewed version.

trophies.name: Showroom Floor
trophies.description: Own 10 or more vehicles across your garages.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA Online's garage trophies. Steal or buy vehicles and store them. Note the missables warning: never sell story-unique cars.

trophies.name: Show Off
trophies.description: Complete all stunt jumps.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Show Off' (25 stunt jumps). Stunt jumps are marked once discovered; land in the target zone. Do them progressively; a couple are finicky — retry from the nearest save.

trophies.name: Sunbird Pilot
trophies.description: Fly every type of aircraft.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Helicopter, fixed-wing, and possibly seaplane given the Keys. Get one flight in each type from an airfield or spawned ones.

trophies.name: Saltwater Cowboy
trophies.description: Pilot every type of watercraft.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The Keys and cruise-ship VC Port guarantee boats, jet skis and likely a yacht or submersible. Take one of each out for a spin.

trophies.name: Multi-Disciplined
trophies.missableNote: If any hobby is character-locked (GTA V's yoga/tennis were character-specific), play it during that character's story window.
trophies.description: Attain a gold medal in all applicable hobbies and pastimes.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's exact 'Multi-Disciplined'. Hobbies per Rockstar's region tour: hunting, fishing, off-roading (Mount Kalaga), plus projected tennis, golf, and beach activities in Vice City. One gold in each.

trophies.name: Gone Fishin'
trophies.description: Catch one of every fish species.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Fishing is heavily implied by the Keys and Mount Kalaga region descriptions. Different species by location and time of day; the rarest needs a boat offshore.

trophies.name: Backwoods Bounty
trophies.description: Complete a hunting challenge or bag every huntable animal.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Mount Kalaga offers 'prime hunting' (Rockstar). Bag each species once; use stealth and the right weapon class.

trophies.name: Street Legend
trophies.description: Win a race in every racing discipline (street, sea, air).
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's street/sea/air race triplet. Win one of each; vehicle upgrades from the shop make this straightforward.

trophies.name: Red Mist
trophies.missableNote: GTA V rampages were Trevor-only; if Leonida's equivalent is single-protagonist, finish it before that character's arc closes.
trophies.description: Complete all rampage-style challenges.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Red Mist'. Time-limited kill-quota challenges scattered across the map. Aim for the bonus targets (headshots etc.) in one pass.

trophies.name: Iron Sunbather
trophies.description: Complete a triathlon or multi-discipline endurance event.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's triathlon. Vice City's beach culture makes swim/bike/run events near-certain. Long event, no skill required — just pacing.

trophies.name: Neon Nights
trophies.description: Experience every type of Vice City nightlife activity.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Vice City's strip club (Boobie's) and projected clubs/bars; visit each venue type and do one activity inside.

trophies.name: Buying Spree
trophies.description: Purchase every type of business or property available.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's property trophies ('All's Fare in Love and War' cab company, 'TP Industries Arms Race', 'Waste Management' dock). Buy one of each business type and complete its associated activity.

trophies.name: The Good Life
trophies.description: Reach a seven-figure net worth across assets and cash.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Lucia 'wants the good life her mom has dreamed of' (Rockstar bio) — expect a wealth-accumulation trophy. Heist income plus investments; the stock-market exploit pattern from GTA V (Lester assassinations) may recur.

trophies.name: Three Star Sunset
trophies.description: Survive 3 minutes on at least a 3-star wanted level with both protagonists off-mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's 'Three Man Army'. Switch characters while surviving so both accumulate; use a garage or alley to break line of sight.

trophies.name: Wanted: Alive or Alive
trophies.missableNote: GTA V's bail-bond strand was missable mid-story; do side-content like this when it first appears.
trophies.description: Capture a bounty target alive.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Wanted: Alive or Alive'. Bounty-hunt side jobs; use a non-lethal takedown on the target and deliver them.

trophies.name: Kifflom!
trophies.missableNote: The Epsilon cult in GTA V required specific donations and could be failed; do cult-style missions when they open.
trophies.description: Complete your path to enlightenment... or not.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Kifflom!'. A cult storyline is a GTA tradition; follow all its steps and make the required choices or donations.

trophies.name: A New Perspective
trophies.description: Play in first person mode for 15 hours.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V PS5's 'A New Perspective' (15 hours in first person). It accumulates while you play normally if you set first person as the default camera — flip the setting early and forget about it.

trophies.name: Out of Your Depth
trophies.description: Encounter something big while diving.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Out of Your Depth' (the shark encounter). Swim deep off the Keys coast until a shark shows up.

trophies.name: Run Like The Wind
trophies.description: Evade a maximum wanted level for an extended pursuit.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA Online's 'Run Like The Wind'. Get to 4-5 stars and lose the cops: swap cars, use alleys, or dive off a boat at sea.

trophies.name: Clean Sweep
trophies.description: Clear an ambush without dying and take down at least 10 attackers.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA Online's 'Clean Sweep'. Gang-attack-style ambush spots; keep cover, use headshots, and never push into the open.

trophies.name: Peak Condition
trophies.description: Max out a character's core stats.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA V maxed stats through practice (stamina, strength, stealth, flying, driving, lung capacity). The projected equivalent: grind each skill's boost activity (cycling, gym, diving under water, flying lessons).
